summary: Lucid Diagnostics Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an underwritten public offering of 18,000,000 shares of common stock at $1.00 per share, expected to raise $16.92 million net proceeds. The offering is conducted under an existing S-3 shelf registration. Shares trade on Nasdaq under LUCD; last price $1.31 on April 22, 2026. Delivery is scheduled for April 24, 2026. Underwriters include Canaccord Genuity and BTIG. This is a routine capital raise via a shelf takedown, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist, tender, going-private, restructuring, liquidation, or other special-situation event is present. The filing is an ordinary equity offering for general corporate purposes.
